caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned upright at the center of a plain, off-white background. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body that tapers toward a short neck with a wide, circular opening at the top. Attached to the neck is a single, thick handle that arches and connects to the upper part of the body. The entire jug is rendered in shades of brown, with areas of lighter tan and yellow suggesting reflections or surface irregularities. The base of the jug is slightly visible and shows a ring with patches of reddish-brown color. There are no additional objects or notable markings in the background, which is uniformly light in color. The artist’s signature and date, written in small, gray text, appear in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Yellow Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
